title: Hashed seed-output distribution
statement: Let $S$, $\alpha$, and $\beta$ be finite sets, with $S$ and $\beta$ nonempty. Given a function $f:S\times\alpha\to\beta$ and a probability distribution $X$ on $\alpha$, define a distribution on $S\times\beta$ by choosing $s$ uniformly from $S$ and $a$ according to $X$, independently, and recording $(s,f(s,a))$.
